title: Workspace requests
description: Requests through the workspace routers, from the spans nginx sends when request tracing is turned on for a workspace.

list.name: workspace
list.label: Workspace
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT workspace FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
) ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(workspace)

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT workspace FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
) ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(workspace)

list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT SpanAttributes['server.address'] FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT SpanAttributes['server.address'] FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(substring(ServiceName, 4), ' / ', SpanAttributes['server.address']) AS server, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']), '$path') > 0, $path) GROUP BY time, server ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, if(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) = 0, 'none', concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])), 100)), 'xx')) AS status, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']), '$path') > 0, $path) GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p50, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p95, quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p99
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']), '$path') > 0, $path) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(substring(ServiceName, 4), ' / ', SpanAttributes['server.address']) AS server, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 500) / count() AS value
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']), '$path') > 0, $path) GROUP BY time, server ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top paths

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['server.address'] AS Server, if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']) AS Path, count() AS Requests,
  countIf(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 500) / count() AS `5xx`, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 400 AND toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) < 500) / count() AS `4xx`,
  quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p50, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p95
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']), '$path') > 0, $path) GROUP BY Server, Path ORDER BY Requests DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Slowest and failed requests

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS Time, substring(ServiceName, 4) AS Workspace, SpanAttributes['server.address'] AS Server, SpanName AS Request, toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS Status,
  Duration / 1e9 AS Duration, TraceId
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(if(SpanAttributes['url.path'] != '', SpanAttributes['url.path'], SpanAttributes['http.target']), '$path') > 0, $path) AND (toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 500 OR Duration > 1e9)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Requests that took over a second or failed with 5xx. Search the TraceId in Explore to see the whole trace, including spans the app sends itself.
